correctness.rationale: Use the cubic Petersen graph with outer pentagon, inner pentagram and five spokes. Exhaustively recounted every 1024 subset and confirmed exact nonempty face totals (75,260,620,785) and mod-two reduced Betti vectors at d=0,1,2,3: respectively 4 in H2, 1 in H3, 1 in H3, 6 in H5. Reconstructed all three fixed-order augmented toggle Morse matchings at d0,d2,d3, giving 36,310,390 pairs, precisely critical masks four 2-cells; one 3-cell; six 5-cells, and directed topological sorts visiting every nonempty face. Independent F2-to-F1 collapse algorithm checks an immediate unique coface and maximality on every step and removed exactly 180 free-face pairs, reaching the 260-face F1 unchanged. Therefore the d1-to-d2 inclusion is a genuine simplicial simple-homotopy equivalence (not merely rank agreement), and integral wedge homotopy types and persistence follow. Saturation d>=3 is exact because graph maximum degree 3. The result concerns vertex-induced forests, not edge matching complexes.
residual_risks: Explicit discrete Morse/reduction certifies this 10-vertex graph only; not natural equivariant splitting of individual spheres.
